Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Edit the EXACT attached16-piece dungeon growth sheet as source; keep its square canvas,4x4 grid, cell positions, side-view orientation, object baselines and the overall readable painterly silhouettes. The current image is rejected because almost every sprite has the SAME HUE. Make a substantial clear colour redesign using AT LEAST THREE DISTINCT HUE FAMILIES in a coherent complementary triad. Do NOT merely add lighter and darker shades of the original hue. Different material parts and different object categories must visibly carry different hues, AND individual sprites should have2–3 meaningful material colours rather than one flat colour. Use roughly60% main colour,25% support colour,15% accent in each group, interpreted tastefully. Broad hue patches must survive small mobile rendering. Do not cover every item with one shared colour filter.
PALETTE AND MATERIAL PLAN: a lava-dungeon triad of EMBER ORANGE-RED, DARK JADE / MINERAL GREEN, and COOLED BLUE-VIOLET, supported by charcoal. Crystals: obsidian-violet bases, red-orange facets and a few green mineral inclusions. Fungi: burnt-red/copper cup interiors with small jade-green spore markings and deep violet-black stems. Ferns: charcoal-violet stems, ember-red and copper fronds, muted dark green veins and a few curled green shoots. This is heat-adapted fantasy cave vegetation growing near lava: interesting asymmetric serrated/pinnate fronds, blackened roots, not dry wheat or generic brown grass. Keep saturation controlled; no bloom or painted fire.
FOLIAGE CORRECTION: cells9–14 (third row all four cells, fourth row first two) must be SIX DIFFERENT compact FERNS, with clear pinnate/frilled leaflets on gently arching fronds and some curled unfurling shoots. Replace all previous grass/wheat forms in these six cells. Low spreading dungeon ferns, not tall stalks. ABSOLUTELY NO WHEAT, grain heads, seed spikes, reed plumes, cattails, crop stalks, flowers or narrow grass tufts. Keep cells1–4 as four crystal clusters, cells5–8 as four mushroom clusters, cells15–16 as two root/twig loops. No added scenery, ground discs, pedestals, architecture or soil bases. Each piece stays compact and separate inside its cell, with its base at local y224. One small connected cluster per cell,16 cells filled, no overlap or clipping. Same chunky hand-painted fantasy game brushwork with broad planes, small-read shapes, not photographic details. Flat even material colour, no directional illumination, cast shadows, bloom, glow halos or backdrop. REAL transparent background with alpha ZERO between and through the sprites; remove any coloured alpha residue/fringes from the source. NO black/white/grey background painted into the art, no checkerboard, labels, numbers or grid lines. Square1024x1024 RGBA PNG.
